projects.name: Swaygent - autonomous agent fleet
projects.oneliner: A self-improving multi-agent pipeline on one Mac mini: it plans, builds, reviews, previews, and ships this very website daily, with the owner reduced to one-tap decisions.
projects.diagram: graph LR; O[Owner via Telegram] -->|one-tap gates| F[Front agent]; F --> S[Scheduler + run queue]; S --> W[Workers: ideation/build/reviewer/qa]; W -->|PR + preview| G[Human gate]; G -->|merge| D[CI -> AWS deploy]; M[(Metrics + evals DB)] --> A[Architect: self-improvement]; A -->|proposals| O; W --> M; S --> M

projects.name: Career Engine - honest resume automation
projects.oneliner: A career memory that interviews you, stores achievements as auditable facts with metric provenance, ranks them per target role, and emits a schema-validated resume artifact.
projects.diagram: graph LR; I[Check-in interview] --> H[(Facts hub: provenance + weights)]; H --> R[rank.py + Elo judge]; R --> W[Resume writer: 5-slot schema, outcome ladder]; W --> E[resume-export.json]; E --> P[Portfolio adapter -> site + PDF]
